name: CO2 Impact
summary: UK carbon reporting software for small and mid-sized businesses: emissions from bills and uploads across Scope 1, 2 and 3, a carbon reduction plan, SECR reports and optional automated meter data.
best_for: UK small and mid-sized businesses that need a first carbon footprint, Scope 1-3 reporting or a carbon reduction plan for customers and tenders, without hiring a consultant
skip_if: you may want to leave within the year (every plan is a 12-month licence and fees are non-refundable), you need multi-country group reporting, or you already work with a sustainability consultancy that supplies its own tools
honest_knock: Every licence is a 12-month commitment, monthly payment included, and the licence terms make fees non-refundable. Data entry and uploads use Usage Tokens, and top-up prices appear only inside the platform. The pricing table changed twice in six weeks (Basic £468 a year in October, £348 on 19 November, with the vendor's llms.txt still showing a third set), so check it at checkout. We have not used CO2 Impact ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per year (£29/mo) for 1 user and 1 site
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-19 in the pricing section of co2impact.co.uk's homepage, GBP, excluding VAT) Basic is £348 a year (£29.00 a month) for 1 user and 1 site. Professional is £549 a year (£45.75 a month) for 2 users and 5 sites. Premium is £948 a year (£79.00 a month) for unlimited users and unlimited sites. Every plan is a 12-month licence: the page says annual payment is charged upfront, monthly payment is spread over the 12-month licence, and prices shown exclude VAT. Every plan lists the web platform (manual or Excel upload), the mobile app, bill and receipt forwarding by email, a ChatGPT plugin, full Scope 1, 2 and 3 reporting, a carbon reduction plan and multiple emission reports by activity; Professional adds SECR reporting and Metrics, and Premium adds manufactured products. The table keeps changing. The vendor's own llms.txt, read the same day, still lists a different set (Essentials £369 a year for 2 users and 2 sites, Professional £749 for 10 users and 5 sites, Enterprise £1,899), an earlier read on 19 November showed that Essentials table on the homepage too, and our reads of 9 and 22 October 2026 showed four plans (Basic £468 a year, Professional £599, Premium £729, Platinum £1,199). We quote the homepage table because that is where you buy. The licence terms (last updated 21 September 2026) add a Usage Token allowance per plan and paid top-ups whose prices are shown only inside the platform.
